items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: I remember hearing Herbie Hancock some years ago, he had done an arrangement of I think “I Love You,” the Cole Porter.

ctx.x: Does the creation of a new set of chords, is that a challenge to you? © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

Um hum. Yeah. For instance if I’m taking a standard tune and I want to do something a bit different with it — like we had this arrangement of “‘S Wonderful” that we do and now not that that tune needs anything reworked, because it’s a great, immensely crafted tune, I mean we’re talking about Gershwin so Gershwins don’t need anybody to be writing anything. But certainly to make the tune to have it reflect the personality of the quartet we work with and — not to bring it up to date but to add a little twist — and…
Yeah. I always like it when I hear a new song and after it’s done I can remember it.
